```{r setup, include = FALSE}

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(wesanderson)
library(fontawesome)
library(ggtext)
library(showtext)
library(flextable)

essa <- read_csv("data/dashboard_essa.csv") %>% 
  filter(countyname == "Solano",
         rtype == "S") %>% 
  mutate(studentGroup = as_factor(studentgroup),
         color = as_factor(color),
         studentGroupLong = fct_relevel(as_factor(student_group_long),
                                    "All students",
                                    "American Indian or Alaska Native",
                                    "Asian",
                                    "Black/African American",
                                    "Filipino",
                                    "Hispanic",
                                    "Pacific Islander",
                                    "White",
                                    "Multiple Races/Two or more",
                                    "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
                                    "Homeless Youth",
                                    "Students with Disabilities",
                                    "Foster Youth",
                                    "English Learner",
                                    "English Learners Only",
                                    "RFEPs Only",
                                    "English Only",
                                    "Smarter Balanced Assessment",
                                    "CA Alternative Assessment"
                                    ),
                  indicator = case_match(indicator,
                                "ELA" ~ "ELA (DFS)",
                                "Math" ~ "Math (DFS)",
                                "college/career" ~ "college/career\n(status only)",
                                .default = indicator),
                  indicator = fct_relevel(as_factor(indicator), 
                                 "ELA (DFS)", "Math (DFS)", "ELPI", 
                                 "absenteeism", "graduation", 
                                 "suspension")) 

status_colors <- c(
  "lightgrey", "tomato", "orange",
  "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue", "darkgrey"
)

font_add('fa-solid', 'fonts/fa-solid-900.ttf')

```

# `r paste0(params$year, "-", parse_number(params$year) + 1, " ", params$lea)` School Dashboard Summary

## California School Dashboard `r params$year`

The 2023 California School Dashboard (Dashboard) reflects a full return of California's accountability system with the reporting of Status (current year data), Change (the difference from prior year data), and Performance Levels (colors) for all state indicators except the College/Career indicator. Details below represent icon definitions included in the dashboard overview.

![](dashboard-cell-key-CDE-change.png){fig-align="left"}

## `r params$lea` School District Dashboard Overview and DA Eligibility `r params$year`

```{r dashboard-plot, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height = 4.8, fig.width = 8.2}

showtext_auto()

# element_markdown uses <br> for newlines
html_wrap <- function(s, width = 17){
    str_wrap(s, width = width) %>% 
      str_replace_all("\n", "<br>")
  }

essa_filtered <- 
  essa %>% 
  filter(schoolname == params$school,
         student_group_long %in% c(
           "All students",
                                    "American Indian or Alaska Native",
                                    "Asian",
                                    "Black/African American",
                                    "Filipino",
                                    "Hispanic",
                                    "Pacific Islander",
                                    "White",
                                    "Multiple Races/Two or more",
                                    "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
                                    "Homeless Youth",
                                    "Students with Disabilities",
                                    "Foster Youth",
                                    "English Learner")) %>% 
  mutate(student_group_wrapped = str_wrap(student_group_long, width = 17),
         change = if_else(is.na(change), "", paste(change)),
         change_arrow = if_else(indicator %in% c("ELA (DFS)", "Math (DFS)", "ELPI", 
                           "graduation", "college/career\n(status only)"),
                                case_match(changelevel,
                                   0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
                                   1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
                                   2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
                                   3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
                                   4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
                                   5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
                                   .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"),
                                                                case_match(changelevel,
                                   0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
                                   5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
                                   4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
                                   3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
                                   2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
                                   1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
                                   .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"))) %>% 
  arrange(student_group_long)

group_count <-
  essa_filtered %>% 
  select(student_group_long) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  nrow()

group_order <- 
  essa_filtered %>% 
  select(student_group_long) %>% 
  unique() %>%  
  arrange(student_group_long) %>% 
  mutate(order = c(1:group_count))

atsi_eligible <- 
  essa_filtered %>% 
  left_join(group_order, by = join_by(student_group_long)) %>% 
  mutate(
        student_group_markdown = if_else(atsi_years > 0,
                      paste("<span style='color: darkred;face: bold'>",           # Group is eligible
                            html_wrap(student_group_long, width = 17),
                                       "</span>"),
                      paste("<span style='color: black'>",            # group is not eligible
                            html_wrap(student_group_long, width = 17),
                                       "</span>")),
         student_group_markdown = fct_reorder(student_group_markdown, 
                                              order)) %>% 
  select(cds, student_group_long, student_group_markdown, order)

essa_filtered %>% 
  left_join(atsi_eligible, by = join_by(cds, student_group_long)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_richtext(x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
            mapping = aes(label = if_else(indicator == "ELA (DFS)" |
                                          indicator == "Math (DFS)" |
                                          is.na(currstatus), 
                                          paste(currstatus, change_arrow, change),
                                          paste0(currstatus, "% ", change_arrow, " ", change)),
                          fill = color),
            show.legend = FALSE,
            text.color = "black",
            label.size = 0.8,
            size = 3.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors,
                    drop = FALSE,
                    na.value = "white") +
  # scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = NA, "TRUE" = "darkred"),
  #                    na.value = "transparent") +
  facet_grid(student_group_markdown ~ indicator, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  labs(caption = "Red indicates the student group meets criteria used to determine CSI-low performance eligibility.") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text.y = element_markdown(size = 11, angle = 0, vjust = 0.7, hjust = 0),
    strip.clip = "off",
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

showtext_auto(FALSE)
```

## Comprehensive Support and Improvement (CSI) Eligibility

In accordance with ESSA, schools are eligible for CSI if they receive at least one color coded performance level on any state indicator and meet the criteria in one of the following categories:

1.  CSI--Low Graduation Rate For 2023, the CSI--Low Graduation Rate category consists of schools that have a three--year graduation rate (i.e., the combined four-and five-year high school graduation rate) that is below 68 percent. This graduation rate criteria applies to both Title I--funded schools and non-Title I-funded schools.

2.  CSI--Low Performing For 2023, the CSI--Low Performing category consists of schools that received Title I funding for the 2022--23 school year and are the lowest performing based on the 2023 Dashboard data. No less than five percent of the Title I--funded schools must be included in this category.

The complete details for determining eligibility can be found in the technical guide for CSI released by the CA Department of Education. [Download the guide here.](https://cde.ca.gov/ta/ac/cm/documents/dbguideessa23.docx)

Results from the 2022 and 2023 Dashboards are used in CSI eligibility determinations. Table 1 provides a summary of the student groups eligible for DA in `r params$lea` School District for `r params$year`.

```{r csi-table}
#| label: csi-eligible
#| echo: FALSE
#| tbl-cap: "Details of CSI Eligbility"
#| cap-location: bottom

essa_filtered %>%
  filter((CSI_2023 == "CSI Grad" & student_group_long == "All students") |
           CSI_2023 == "CSI Low Perform") %>% 
  mutate(
    currstatus = case_when(
                        indicator == "ELA (DFS)" ~ paste0(currstatus),
                        indicator == "Math (DFS)" ~ paste0(currstatus),
                        .default = paste0(currstatus, "%")),
     n_count = case_when(indicator == "ELA (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "Math (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "college/career\n(status only)" ~ currdenom,
                       .default = currnumer),
    currnumer_str = case_when(indicator == "ELA (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "Math (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "college/career\n(status only)" ~ "*",
                       .default = as.character(currnumer))) %>%
  select(student_group_long, indicator, currnumer_str, currdenom, currstatus, change, atsi_years) %>%
  arrange(student_group_long) %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  line_spacing(space = 0.2,
               part = "body") %>% 
  set_header_labels(
    student_group_long = "Student Group",
    indicator = "Indicator", 
    # n_count = "N count",
    currnumer_str = "Numerator",
    currdenom = "Denominator",
    currstatus = "Current Status",
    change = "Change",
    atsi_year = "Years in ATSI") %>%
  # width(width = c(2, 1, 1, 1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.5)) %>%
  # align(align = c("left", "left", "right", "right", "right", "right", "right"), part = "all") %>% 
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")

```

```{r atsi-table}
#| label: atsi-eligible
#| echo: FALSE
#| tbl-cap: "Student groups eligible for ATSI"
#| cap-location: bottom

essa_filtered %>% 
  filter(atsi_years > 0) %>% 
  mutate(
    currstatus = case_when(
                        indicator == "ELA (DFS)" ~ paste0(currstatus),
                        indicator == "Math (DFS)" ~ paste0(currstatus),
                        .default = paste0(currstatus, "%")),
     n_count = case_when(indicator == "ELA (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "Math (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "college/career\n(status only)" ~ currdenom,
                       .default = currnumer),
    currnumer_str = case_when(indicator == "ELA (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "Math (DFS)" | 
                       indicator == "college/career\n(status only)" ~ "*",
                       .default = as.character(currnumer))) %>%
  select(student_group_long, indicator, currnumer_str, currdenom, currstatus, change, atsi_years) %>%
  arrange(student_group_long) %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  line_spacing(space = 0.2,
               part = "body") %>% 
  set_header_labels(
    student_group_long = "Student Group",
    indicator = "Indicator", 
    # n_count = "N count",
    currnumer_str = "Numerator",
    currdenom = "Denominator",
    currstatus = "Current Status",
    change = "Change",
    atsi_year = "Years in ATSI") %>%
  # width(width = c(2, 1, 1, 1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.5)) %>%
  # align(align = c("left", "left", "right", "right", "right", "right", "right"), part = "all") %>% 
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")

```

\* No numerator for this indicator.
